correctness.rationale: At the interior equilibrium the Jacobian has zero diagonal and off-diagonal entries \(A_Ax^*(1-x^*)\) and \(A_By^*(1-y^*)\); hence its determinant is the negative product of those entries. The sign classification therefore reverses Proposition 7.1. The source payoff definitions give \(A_I=S_I+\operatorname{exp}^I(0)+\operatorname{exc}^I(0)\ge0\); existence of an interior equilibrium requires the relevant \(A_I\ne0\), so both are strictly positive. The source first integral remains valid but supports the center only when the corrected product sign is negative. The source itself later describes the coordination mixed equilibrium as a saddle, which is consistent with the corrected determinant and inconsistent with its Proposition 7.1.

evidence: Generic replicator theory contains the zero-diagonal Jacobian pattern, but no located prior source applies the corrected sign to this tariff model and derives positivity of both interaction coefficients.

value.rationale: The correction changes the local phase portrait of the only interior tariff equilibrium from the paper’s advertised cycling regime to instability and resolves an internal contradiction with its coordination discussion. Although the determinant calculation is elementary, the consequence is substantive for the paper’s central dynamic interpretation, so this is a motivated mathematical correction rather than a cheap sign check.
residual_risks: The finding corrects local and qualitative dynamics; it does not re-evaluate the paper’s static welfare model or empirical policy assumptions.

final_claim: For the two-population tariff replicator system \(\dot x=x(1-x)(A_Ay+B_A)\), \(\dot y=y(1-y)(A_Bx+B_B)\), the determinant at an interior equilibrium is \(-A_AA_Bx^*(1-x^*)y^*(1-y^*)\), not the positive-sign expression printed in Proposition 7.1 of the source. Consequently \(A_AA_B>0\) gives a saddle and \(A_AA_B<0\) gives the center branch. In the tariff model itself, every existing interior equilibrium has \(A_A>0\) and \(A_B>0\), so the claimed center regime is impossible and the coordination case is necessarily a saddle.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the replicator subsystem and its local/global qualitative classification, not the empirical validity of reciprocal-tariff assumptions.
